prior_rendered_markdown_repairs.meaning: These earlier, documented presentation repairs trimmed rendered Markdown whitespace and normalized rendered newlines before staging. Their old/new hashes remain in the freeze receipt. They did not alter paired raw JSON. This supplemental capture does not repeat or rewrite them.

git_normalization_meaning: For each affected path, the captured working byte stream differs from the indexed blob exclusively by replacing every CRLF pair with LF. Actual attributes and both SHA-256 hashes/blob IDs are recorded. Original working bytes and index bytes are preserved externally. No original receipt or evidence index was rewritten.
scope_limit: Artifact preservation only. No source/test edits, staging, commit, test execution, quality-gate replay, or new task acceptance. The four frozen source/test paths and all 39 staged evidence paths remain byte-identical to this capture.
